milestones.title: Build Kubernetes Deployment & Service Manifests
milestones.whyItMatters: Stripe expects production container orchestration proof. Your CKA certification provides theoretical knowledge, but adding Helm manifests to api-gateway completes verified code proof.
actions: Write production deployment.yaml with liveness and readiness probes
Configure ClusterIP service and Ingress routing rules
Define resource requests/limits and Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA)
Package configuration into reusable Helm chart template
milestones.completionCriteria: Verified Helm chart and production deployment YAML manifests committing to api-gateway repository.

milestones.title: Implement Automated GitHub Actions CI/CD Pipeline
milestones.whyItMatters: Automated linting, race condition testing, and container publishing demonstrate production engineering maturity.
actions: Create .github/workflows/ci.yml with Go test matrix and race detector
Add automated Docker build and container vulnerability scanning
Integrate automated branch protection rules
milestones.completionCriteria: Green CI build workflow running unit tests with race detection and publishing multi-arch container images.

milestones.title: Containerize API Gateway with Multi-Stage Alpine Builds
milestones.whyItMatters: Minimal attack surface and unprivileged container runtime execution.
actions: Create multi-stage Dockerfile building Go binary into minimal Alpine image
Configure non-root user execution and health check endpoints
Add docker-compose.yml for local cluster orchestration with Redis
milestones.completionCriteria: Multi-stage Dockerfile verified with 0 vulnerability findings.

milestones.title: Implement Cluster Quorum Chaos Testing in Distributed Cache
milestones.whyItMatters: Validates split-brain recovery and Raft consensus safety under network partitions.
actions: Write cluster partition simulation script dropping network packets between nodes
Verify leader re-election safety and term increment invariants
Add benchmark measuring write latency during minority partition failover
milestones.completionCriteria: Automated partition test passing with zero split-brain state discrepancies.

milestones.title: Instrument OpenTelemetry Distributed Tracing & Metrics
milestones.whyItMatters: Production observability across microservice hops is a hallmark of senior engineering roles.
actions: Add OpenTelemetry SDK tracer provider to Go HTTP middleware
Propagate W3C tracecontext headers across outbound client requests
Export Prometheus metrics for request duration histograms and error rates
milestones.relatedResumeEvidence: Improved query latency by 40% with Redis caching
milestones.completionCriteria: Trace headers propagated across HTTP router with Prometheus /metrics endpoint.

milestones.title: Optimize PostgreSQL Advisory Locks & Index Execution Plans
milestones.whyItMatters: Demonstrates high-scale transactional safety and query execution optimization.
actions: Implement SKIP LOCKED worker queue polling in task-orchestrator
Run EXPLAIN ANALYZE on complex join queries and add partial index
Document connection pooling limits under high concurrency
milestones.relatedResumeEvidence: PostgreSQL transaction management and connection pooling
milestones.completionCriteria: Advisory locking query execution time under 5ms at 1000 concurrent requests.

milestones.title: Publish Comprehensive Architecture & Benchmark Whitepapers
milestones.whyItMatters: Elite hiring managers prioritize written communication and clear technical documentation.
actions: Write detailed architecture overview in api-gateway README with Mermaid diagrams
Document performance benchmark throughput numbers (RPS, p99 latency)
Publish deployment step-by-step walkthrough
milestones.relatedResumeEvidence: Technical blog authoring with Next.js MDX
milestones.completionCriteria: Complete architecture diagrams and reproducible k6 benchmark results published in repo.

milestones.title: Validate Raft Log Replication Invariants Under Partitions
milestones.whyItMatters: Google backend engineering demands rigorous proof of distributed algorithms and consensus safety.
actions: Write chaos test simulating network drops between Raft peers
Verify log index monotonic progression and commit safety
Benchmark leader election timeout under randomized jitter
milestones.relatedResumeEvidence: Built distributed caching engines in Go
milestones.completionCriteria: Passing Raft consensus unit test suite with race detector enabled.

milestones.title: Implement Bidirectional Streaming gRPC Service
milestones.whyItMatters: High-throughput binary RPCs are the backbone of Google's internal microservices infrastructure.
actions: Define Protobuf v3 streaming service contracts
Implement concurrent Go client and server streaming handlers
Add keepalive parameters and deadline propagation
milestones.relatedResumeEvidence: Low-latency microservices with Node.js and Go
milestones.completionCriteria: Validated bidirectional streaming gRPC service with client benchmarks.

milestones.title: Establish Cloud Container Infrastructure Evidence
milestones.whyItMatters: Proves reproducible deployment standards for enterprise technology targets.
actions: Configure Docker containerization manifests
Add automated CI pipeline in GitHub Actions
Document environment variable injection and secret management
milestones.completionCriteria: Automated CI/CD pipeline building and verifying container deployments.
